```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "GOT" >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS abnormal_rate
FROM main."Laboratory"
WHERE "Date" >= '1997-01-01' AND "Date" <= '1997-12-31'
  AND "GOT" IS NOT NULL;
```
